verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs describe two official Model Context Protocol servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod, and a probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. One server manages Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes and registries through the REST API, authenticating with Sign in with Runpod or an API key. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the servers work, a description of what the second server covers, and per-client setup or tool-list detail.
